newsitem.title: CANADA: Trizec says no comment on Houston report.
newsitem.headline: Trizec says no comment on Houston report.

text.p: Trizec Corp Ltd on Wednesday declined to comment on a report in the Houston Chronicle which said it was expected to buy a large office and hotel complex in downtown Houston for up to US$250 million.
"I can't really comment. We are continuing to look at acquisitions in the U.S. office market," said Laurie Ludwick, a spokesman for Trizec, North America's largest publicly traded real estate firm.
"I can't really comment on potential transactions that we may be looking at," she added.
The newspaper, citing real estate sources, said the deal was likely to be completed in November.

The building, called Allen Center, has been shopped around since April by owner Metropolitan Life Insurance. It includes three office buildings, the tallest having 50 stories, and a 341-room Doubletree Hotel.
Trizec already owns a nearby office complex -- Cullen Center -- in downtown Houston.
